$comment: The CodeMie web stack: every agent is a stored CodeMie assistant. The ladders are the claude set's, inherited by name so the two cannot drift; the runner is plugins/providers/codemie-web/.
$why: Operator, 2026-09-28: pipeline agents as CodeMie web assistants, visible to the team once proven — a HARD REQUIREMENT, equally important as GHCP. The claude ladder ids exist in CodeMie's catalog under the same names (verified against llms.list() on 2026-09-28), so the ladder's model is passed to each chat as it is (llm_model) and checked against the catalog at pre-flight.

inheritFrom.$whyOnlyThese: The claude RUNNER is not inherited: a set declaring both runners makes `claude` routable, and resolve_primary_provider could route a codemie-web run to it.

finalFallback.$why: The claude set's fallback model, served by CodeMie: the same second answer after ladder exhaustion, on this stack.

codemie-web.$whyNoFlags: Not a command-line runner: the call is a chat with a stored assistant (plugins/providers/codemie-web/). The model travels as llm_model per chat; CodeMie's chat has no reasoning-effort parameter, so the ladder's effort is carried only by its choice of model.
codemie-web.$whyToolNames: The CodeMie Plugin tools behind each pipeline tool name (the runner's vocabulary, as every runner declares one).
codemie-web.$whyPlugins: Which local CodeMie Plugin serves a grant, in order: the FIRST whose `provides` covers every granted tool this runner declares (toolNames). No grant is the runner's full set — the LAST plugin — as on the claude runner, where a seam with no grant keeps the default tool set. A granted tool this runner does not declare is dropped and said aloud. ro = the pipeline's read-only toolkit (plugin_ro.py); rw = the codemie-plugins development toolkit.
codemie-web.$whyHostedToolPlugins: The pipeline's own ToolPlugins (paths relative to orchestrations/) hosted by this set's local CodeMie plugin, so a CodeMie web assistant gets the same tool — same name, schema and execution — as any other runner. Without it codegraph_query was dropped on this set and the detective had list/read/search only (operator, 2026-10-01: 'without this the pipeline will not work at all').
